shots.title: EXP-38 run 1: the two props from other maps, their lighting baked for the bar's car park

marks.text: the lamp post from URB_PoliceStation: lit as the car park's own pieces beside it
the alien wall panel from CAbductor_Cliffside: lit as the car park, no longer as the alien ship

shots.title: EXP-38 run 1: seen from the bar's front door, looking at the street

marks.text: lamp post: no brighter and no darker than the cars and the kerb around it
alien wall: the car park's dim light on it, darker on the side away from the moon; no bright patch, no black one
the ground between them: each prop's shadow lies on it, as the cars' shadows do
